import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import os

# Disable progress bars
os.environ["LIGHTGBM_BUILTIN_PROGRESS_BAR"] = "0"

# Create submission directory
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_full = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_full.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test.shape}")

# Identify features and target
target_col = "Cover_Type"
feature_cols = [c for c in train_full.columns if c != "Id" and c != target_col]

X_train_full = train_full[feature_cols].copy()
y_train_full = train_full[target_col].copy()
X_test = test[feature_cols].copy()
test_ids = test["Id"].values

print(f"Number of features: {len(feature_cols)}")
print(f"Unique classes: {y_train_full.nunique()}")

# Split training into train/validation (80-20)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_full, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_full
)

print(f"\nTraining set: {len(X_train)} samples")
print(f"Validation set: {len(X_val)} samples")

# Create LightGBM datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

# Define hyperparameters
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "metric": "multi_logloss",
    "num_class": y_train_full.nunique(),
    "verbose": -1,
    "force_row_wise": True,
}

# Train model on train set only
print("\nTraining LightGBM model on training split...")
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=2000,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=100, verbose=False)],
)

# Evaluate on validation set
print("\nEvaluating on validation set...")
val_pred = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
val_pred_classes = np.argmax(val_pred, axis=1)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, val_pred_classes)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Retrain on full training data for final predictions
print("\nRetraining on full training data...")
full_train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train_full, label=y_train_full)
final_model = lgb.train(
    params,
    full_train_data,
    num_boost_round=2000,
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=100, verbose=False)],
)

# Generate predictions on test set
print("\nGenerating test predictions...")
test_pred = final_model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=final_model.best_iteration)
test_pred_classes = np.argmax(test_pred, axis=1)

# Create submission file
print("\nSaving submission file...")
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_ids, "Cover_Type": test_pred_classes})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")

# Print final validation accuracy again
print(f"\n=== Final Validation Accuracy ===")
print(f"{val_accuracy:.6f}")
